map.title: Friends map
map.consentLead: Your friends will see you on the map and can find you or get directions to you. You can stop at any time.
map.consentWho: Only the people you choose below can see you, and never anyone you have blocked.
map.consentOnlyOpen: Your position is updated only while this map is open in the app, never in the background.
map.consentNoHistory: Only your current position is kept, never a history. It disappears 8 hours after your last update.
map.consentAdult: Location sharing is available to people aged 18 and over.
map.consentFooter: You can change who sees you or stop sharing from the settings button on the map.
map.visibility_friends_hint: People you follow who follow you back
map.visibility_public_hint: Anyone on FLYP who can see your profile
map.notNow: Not now, just look at the map
map.permissionDenied: Location permission is off for FLYP. Allow it to share your position.
map.permissionOff: Location permission is off, so your position is not being updated. Tap to open settings.
map.errAdult: Location sharing is only available to people aged 18 and over. Add your date of birth in your profile if you have not.
map.errSignedOut: You are signed out. Sign in again and try once more.
map.errGeneric: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
map.loadFailed: Could not load this. Check your connection.
map.loadFailedRetry: Could not load. Tap to try again.
map.statusSharingA11y: You are sharing your location with {{who}}. Opens location settings.
map.statusOffA11y: You are not sharing your location. Tap to start.
map.statusOff: You are not sharing your location
map.stopSharingBody: Your position is deleted straight away and nobody will see you on the map.
map.approveBody: They will see you on their map while you share your location. You can take this back at any time.
map.noTracking: Nobody has approved a request from you yet.
map.noFriendsBody: When people you follow share their location with you, they appear here.
map.sheetHint: Swipe up or tap to see the list
map.followHint: Keeps the map centred on them as they move
map.followingHint: The map follows {{name}}. Move the map to stop.
map.directionsFailed: Could not open a maps app.
map.askTrackQ: Ask {{name}} to share their location with you?
map.askTrackBody: They will get a request and can allow or deny it.
map.permitSentBody: {{name}} will be asked to share their location with you.
map.unavailableBody: The map is not available in this version of the app. Your friends list, distances and directions still work below.
map.placesEmptyMe: Add a place when you post and it will show on your map.
